description: This file contains utility functions, constants, and type definitions used across the Mattermost server codebase, including string manipulation, JSON marshaling, ID generation, validation, and error handling.

classes.name: AppError
classes.description: Represents an application error with support for translation, wrapping, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the AppError, including where, message, detailed error, and wrapped error.

methods.name: Translate
methods.description: Translates the AppError message using the provided translation function.

methods.name: SystemMessage
methods.description: Returns the system message for the AppError, optionally translated.

methods.name: ToJSON
methods.description: Serializes the AppError to a JSON string.

methods.name: wrappedToDetailed
methods.description: Appends the wrapped error's message to the detailed error string.

methods.name: Wrap
methods.description: Wraps an error inside the AppError.

methods.name: WipeDetailed
methods.description: Clears the detailed error and wrapped error.
